title: Bloom's Taxonomy
description: Interactive visualization of Bloom's Taxonomy cognitive levels for educational design and learning objectives.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Education
Learning Theory
Bloom's Taxonomy
Instructional Design
learningObjectives: Identify the six cognitive levels of the taxonomy triangle in order from Remember at the base through Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create at the apex
Distinguish Remember, which retrieves facts and terminology from long-term memory, from Understand, which constructs meaning by interpreting and summarizing
Explain why Analyze breaks material into constituent parts while Evaluate makes judgments against criteria and standards
Classify a given learning objective into the correct taxonomy level using the hover descriptions and their associated verbs
Design a learning objective at the Create level in which students build or modify their own MicroSim
